source_evidence: These “asset-based fees” might be ongoing, whether there are transactions in your account or not.
question: Misconception: An adviser can charge fees only when a trade happens, so I won’t owe an advisory fee in months when there are no transactions.
answer: Correction: Advisory fees may be hourly or fixed/flat and based on time spent or specific transactions. They may also be asset-based and ongoing even when there are no transactions. Check the advisory contract to understand how the fees are calculated.
